name: aurix-ai-agent-extension
description: AURIX™-native Copilot agent — generate, build, and flash TriCore™ from a single chat prompt.

aurix-ai-agent.selectedBoard.description: Selected target board for generated AI context.

aurix-ai-agent.selectedDevice.description: Legacy compatibility mirror of the selected board name.

aurix-ai-agent.defaultBuildCommand.description: Optional project build command written to .aurix-ai/context.json. If empty, the extension infers a make-based incremental build when possible.

aurix-ai-agent.defaultBuildCwd.description: Optional working directory for the build command written to .aurix-ai/context.json. Supports ${workspaceFolder}, ${workspaceRoot}, ${program}, ${device}.

aurix-ai-agent.buildToolchainPath.description: AURIX Development Studio or Configuration Studio installation root (standard or Limited). The extension detects make, tricore-elf-gcc, and AURIX Flasher from this path.

aurix-ai-agent.contextRelativePath.description: Relative path for AI context file.

aurix-ai-agent.devicesJsonPath.description: Optional path to devices.json if auto-discovery from aurix-tcf extension is not available.

enumDescriptions: Use the bundled uv runtime (auto-provisions Python + dependencies); otherwise fall back to a compatible Python interpreter.
Always launch via uv. The extension includes uv; it downloads a managed Python and the server's dependencies automatically.
Always launch via a Python interpreter (see aurix-ai-agent.pythonPath). Requires the server's dependencies to be installed.
aurix-ai-agent.mcpRuntime.description: How to launch the bundled AURIX MCP server. 'auto' (recommended) uses the included uv runtime, so no Python or uv installation is needed.

aurix-ai-agent.uvPath.description: Optional uv override used to launch the AURIX MCP server. By default the extension uses its bundled uv.exe. Supports ${workspaceFolder}, ${workspaceRoot}, ${extensionPath}.

aurix-ai-agent.uvPython.description: Python version uv provisions for the MCP server (e.g. 3.12). uv downloads it automatically if not present.

aurix-ai-agent.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter used to launch the bundled AURIX MCP server when runtime is 'python' (or 'auto' without uv). Must provide the server's Python dependencies (mcp, httpx). Supports ${workspaceFolder}, ${workspaceRoot}, ${extensionPath}.

aurix-ai-agent.pythonServerDir.description: Directory of the Python MCP server (containing src/aurix_mcp_server). Used to set PYTHONPATH when the package is not pip-installed. Supports ${workspaceFolder}, ${workspaceRoot}, ${extensionPath}.

aurix-ai-agent.mcpServerArgs.description: Arguments passed to the Python interpreter. If empty, the extension uses -m aurix_mcp_server.

aurix-ai-agent.mcpServerCwd.description: Working directory for MCP server process.

aurix-ai-agent.installCopilotInstruction.markdownDeprecationMessage: Deprecated. Use the **Generate Copilot Config** command or the Configurator panel instead.
aurix-ai-agent.installCopilotInstruction.description: Legacy: auto-install copilot-instructions on activation. Use the Configurator panel instead.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p ./ && npm run sync-skills
